name: RealFi USDrf
oneLiner: USDrf is RealFi's Cardano dollar token backed by off-chain credit, with a Treasury liquidity buffer and institution-only direct redemption.
collateral: Off-chain Treasury bills, money market funds, floating-rate credit, CLO ETFs and private credit; published allocation ranges describe strategy rather than verified current holdings.
pegMechanism: Whitelisted institutions mint and redeem through a human-approved FIFO queue with daily and monthly limits. Retail exits depend on secondary markets. Protocol first-loss reserves and the junior sUSDrf tranche absorb losses before USDrf.
launchPhaseDetail: RealFi launched USDrf, a dollar token backed by off-chain credit, and its junior staked token sUSDrf on Cardano mainnet on October 1 2026. Supply was 5,403,937 USDrf on Cardano on November 1 2026. Direct minting and redemption are limited to whitelisted institutions under an Institutional Minting Agreement, through a human-approved first-in-first-out queue with daily and monthly limits. Retail holders exit by trading on decentralized exchanges. RealFi's docs name TxPipe, Anastasia Labs and Halborn as auditors and HT Digital as reserve attestation provider, but no audit report or attestation had been published by November 1 2026. Pharos tracks USDrf pre-launch because no admitted source prices it: CoinGecko's realfi-usdrf preview has a null price, and DefiLlama 445 carries a generic fallback quote shared by 90 assets rather than a market price.

milestones.title: RealFi introduces USDr and its staked sUSDr
milestones.description: RealFi's introductory post presents USDr as the protocol's stablecoin and sUSDr as its staked layer. The Cardano asset still carries the on-chain name USDr, while RealFi now brands it USDrf.
